law: OW-19 (lens floor), OW-6b (tracks), OW-13 (model roles), OW-18 (provenance)
status: PROPOSAL. The lens FLOOR is the owner's directive and is not proposed. Everything else here is the orchestrator's reading, for the controlling agent to rule.

source.note: it predates OW-19 by eight days and therefore says nothing about lens count

THE_FINDING_THAT_NEEDS_THE_OWNER.headline: OW-19's lens floor and the campaign's missing Greek witness collide on 27 of the 42 remaining books.
THE_FINDING_THAT_NEEDS_THE_OWNER.measured: the hardness classification records, CONFIRMED from its own inputs, that no Greek New Testament source text is staged for this campaign, and it already rules a staged Greek substrate a Phase-0 precondition for every NT book on either track, with needs_owner = true. That decision has been open since 2026-09-07.
THE_FINDING_THAT_NEEDS_THE_OWNER.what_OW19_adds: before OW-19 the missing substrate blocked the byte-collation close-gate arm. After OW-19 it also blocks the LENS FLOOR itself: on an OT book the second of the two required blind lanes is the original-language lane, and on an NT book there is no staged original language for it to read. A lane reading a translation is not an original-language lane, and recording it as one would be the implied-provenance falsehood OW-18 forbids.
so_the_owner_faces_a_choice_of_two: STAGE A GREEK WITNESS, which the controlling agent has already recommended and escalated: Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Textform as the primary key-aligned witness because its verse existence matches WEB's reported Majority-Text base one-to-one, plus SBLGNT as the secondary witness for critical-text divergence disclosure. NA28/UBS5 and the Tyndale House GNT were ruled ineligible on licence grounds. This is a project-level source, licence and provenance choice that binds the scripture graph beyond this lane and is irreversible in effect once NT rows are keyed.

DEFINE A DIFFERENT SECOND LENS for the NT books, which would satisfy OW-19's floor without a Greek text - for instance a reception/tradition lane reading how the received tradition divided the passage. This is cheaper and weaker: it leaves close-gate item 5's byte-collation arm unsatisfiable for any row carrying Greek, so it is a change to the close gate as well as to the lens plan and should not be chosen merely because it is cheaper.
THE_FINDING_THAT_NEEDS_THE_OWNER.what_is_lost_meanwhile: the hardness file enumerates it concretely: the byte re-verification lane (error classes E-01, E-03, E-04, E-05 are caught only by collation against a staged text), and the verse-existence crosswalk for the many WEB verses absent from critical editions - the NT analogue of the MT/WEB numbering zone that Ezekiel needed.

honest_limits: Track and scores are EXTRACTED from the hardness file. The lens KIND recommendations are INFERRED by mapping each book's severe axes to the lens that would decorrelate that axis; the controlling agent may reject the mapping entirely.
'third_lens_indicated' is a flag for a DECISION, not a decision. OW-19 requires that a third lens be CONSIDERED per book and that the consideration be recorded; it does not require a third lens.
The hardness file records its own effort as 'ordered high, NOT VERIFIED', so its scores carry that caveat forward into every recommendation derived from them here.
Ezekiel appears in this list because the file was written before Ezekiel's cycle; it is book 26 and its primaries are complete.
